---
description: Explain the selected code to a beginner
agent: ask
---
Explain the selected code (or the current file if nothing is selected) to a first-year
student who knows basic Python but not pandas or Streamlit.

- Start with one sentence on what it does overall.
- Then go section by section, using plain language and short examples.
- Point out one thing that could go wrong and how the code handles (or doesn't handle) it.
- Finish with one question the student could try answering themselves to check their understanding.
